name: Larder Indonesia
overview: Larder Indonesia imports and distributes premium food ingredients from global brands, serving foodservice and retail businesses across Indonesia and selling directly to consumers through online marketplaces.
challenges:
- Build brand awareness among foodservice and retail businesses and individual shoppers.
- Earn B2B buyers’ trust by highlighting product quality and reliable supply.
- Make premium ingredients relevant to consumers by showing how they can use them in everyday cooking and baking.
participants: Project Manager, Performance Specialist, Web Developer, Graphic Designer, Social Media Specialist, Copywriter
role:
- Translated the client’s requirements and campaign goals into a clear brief.
- Helped develop the landing page and briefed the UI/UX specialist on the design direction.
- Oversaw campaign execution to keep it running smoothly together with performance specialist.
- Collaborated with the social media team and graphic designer on campaign content and visuals.
